plain: On October 8, 1981, Hannah McRoberts was driving with her husband on Vancouver Island in Canada when she stopped by a well-known mountain and took a photo that shows a flying saucer. A UFO researcher and archivist named Clas Svahn tells Michels the story as McRoberts gave it. If the photo is what it seems, it caught a craft in the sky over a familiar landscape.
